name: get_email_messages
description: Search Gmail by query and return lightweight per-message HEADERS only (subject, sender, date, message_id, a short snippet, and any meeting link). Does NOT return full bodies. To read a message's full body, call get_email_thread with that message's message_id. No importance/summarizer filtering is applied.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: Maximum messages to return (default 25). Returns the most relevant matches for the query.

outputs.description: Matched messages as header rows: message_id, thread_id, subject, sender, email_address, date, snippet, meeting_link. No full body — hydrate via get_email_thread(message_id).

metadata.planner_description: Search Gmail by query -> header rows (subject/sender/date/id/snippet/meeting_link), no bodies. Hydrate a chosen message's full body with get_email_thread(message_id).
